text:
Jordan M.: quick heads-up: found a weird mismatch between node & python SDKs for embeddings+rerank when the batching helper is enabled. node returns fewer embedding objects than requests when a sub-batch gets retried.

Leila P.: ouch. do you have a tiny repro? sounds like an idempotency/merge bug in client-side batch reassembly.

Jordan M.: repro summary: send 7 inputs with batch_helper.max_batch_size=4. node does two sub-batches (4 + 3). server returns 200 for first sub-batch, second sub-batch gets a transient 500 and then client retries. final node response array has 6 embeddings, python has 7.

Owen C.: what does the node helper use to stitch responses? index offsets or per-item ids?

Jordan M.: node uses position-based concat to avoid per-item tags (perf win). python uses per-item uuids. my hypothesis: when retry returns a truncated array the pos-based merge loses an item.

Leila P.: that matches an old issue we talked about last quarter. we optimized bytes on the wire by dropping client ids which made assumptions about stable server-length responses.

Rina S.: quick mitigation options: 1) disable batching helper in node; 2) enable tagging in helper (tag_ids=true) so node will include tiny 8-byte ids; 3) enable include_input on server to map back inputs (expensive).

Jordan M.: tried tag_ids=true, that fixed parity. can we change default to safer behavior when retry logic is on?

Leila P.: yes we should. plan: change node helper to auto-tag when retry/backoff is non-zero. will open a ticket. also add telemetry for sub-batch ids so we can trace replays.

infra-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4510: "node: auto-enable batch item ids when retry/backoff configured" — https://rwd.in/DEVEX-4510

Owen C.: another UX painpoint: node response format for embeddings is an array of vectors and a separate metadata map; python returns list-of-objects which is easier for downstream rerankers. should we standardize?

Leila P.: yes — proposal: optional response_shape=object_items header. server will return [{embedding, input, client_id}] when present. migration: opt-in for one release, then flip default after two releases, keeping compatibility flag.

Jordan M.: sounds good. short-term I'll roll out tag_ids and include_input on my test cluster and rerun load to reproduce. will paste a tiny repro snippet into DEVEX-4510. thanks folks. :raised_hands:

Rina S.: note for platform: if server deduplicates replayed items during retry, we should log that occurrence (dedupe_count) so clients can detect missing items quickly.

Leila P.: agreed. adding server-side dedupe_count to response meta is low-risk and helps debugging.

Jordan M.: putting repro + logs in the ticket now.
